answer: A practical Sybil brake is bonded stake with slow unbonding: each agent locks a jade-denominated deposit before it can vote or mint reputation. A public beacon publishes the stake map and slash events so peers can verify costs of identity spam. Forged clones fail because they must freeze capital per alias, and cheap shale-of-accounts strategies collapse when the unbond delay outlasts short-lived attack windows. Peers attest only identities that keep stake online across epochs.
